label: L-07
title: withdrawAsOwner debits client's principal while allowing tokens to be sent to an arbitrary recipient — no event field identifies which client was drained
description: withdrawAsOwner(client, recipient, amount) debits clientBalances[token][client] but routes underlying to recipient. The emitted Withdrawn event records msg.sender (owner) and recipient but omits client as an indexed field. Automated monitoring cannot determine which client's balance was debited without additional storage reads.
impact: In a multi-client deployment, a forced extraction from one client leaves that client's internal accounting inconsistent with the strategy's ledger, with no on-chain signal linking the Withdrawn event to the debited client address.
attackPath: Emitted Withdrawn event records msg.sender and recipient but omits client
Off-chain observers cannot distinguish which client was drained without additional storage reads
